data.title: [Contingency Contract: Re-Ignition Experimental Operation] Content Update Notes
data.brief: ▼// Update TimeJune 26, 2026 at 12:00 (server time)※ Asia Server Time Zone: UTC+8 ※ Americas / Europ
data.data:
▼// Update Time

June 26, 2026 at 12:00 (server time)

※ Asia Server Time Zone: UTC+8

※ Americas / Europe Server Time Zone: UTC-5


▼// Update Details

Added the following auto-unlocked Test Criteria:

· [Team: Encumbered]

· [Ambient: Time Limit III]

· [Edit: Flashfreeze]

· [Ambient: RE-Construct I]

· [Ambient: RE-Construct II]

If a Criteria Set is still locked, its newly added Test Criteria cannot be selected. Achieve higher Total Test Criteria records to unlock the Criteria Set.


▼// Participation Criteria

· Complete the main mission [Chapter I Process II: Paving the Way]

· Authority Level ≥30


▼// Event Details

· This update adds Phase 2 content to the [Contingency Contract: Re-Ignition Experimental Operation] limited-time challenge event. All basic rules, reward exchange, [Sanctuary Rating], and other mechanics remain unchanged from Phase 1. Freely combine Test Criteria to achieve higher Total Test Criteria records!

· A new cycle mission will be added every 3 days (updated at 04:00 server time) during the event. There are 7 cycle missions in total, and all challenges and missions will remain available until the event ends.


▼// Important Notes

· All Contract Missions and combat challenges will close when the event ends.

· After the event ends, [Secret Sanctuary] will remain open for reward exchange until July 23, 2026 at 04:00 (server time). Once [Secret Sanctuary] closes, all unused [Vitrified Coins] will be cleared.


※ For more event details, check the in-game [Event Center].
